data.raw_text:
I arrived in Cebu for a different agenda, but being here during this difficult time for Cebuanos reminded me that helping will always be part of me. The 12-hour traffic to reach Northern Cebu was draining, challenging, and tiring—but all of it was wiped away after hearing heartfelt “thank yous” and seeing the smiling faces of those affected by the earthquake.

Why challenging? Because we distributed relief goods right at the epicenter, not knowing when the next aftershock would strike. Until now, aftershocks continue some reaching up to magnitude 5, with more than 3k+ recorded aftershocks already.

Let’s continue to keep Cebu, nearby cities, and the rest of Visayas in our prayers, as well as other parts of the Philippines that are enduring different kinds of calamities.

#BangonCebu
